name: Preview a Deposit
summary: See how many raUSDC shares a given USDC deposit would mint, before committing. Read-only.
when_to_use: The agent wants to model a deposit — the shares it would receive at the current exchange rate — without sending a transaction.

outputs.name: shares
outputs.description: raUSDC shares that would be minted

mcp.hint: Ask: 'preview a 100 USDC deposit into Arcis'

risk: Read-only — no transaction, no signature, no risk.
